Contact Lenses

Contact lenses in Garden Grove

Pick up your contact lenses where you get your glasses. We carry popular daily, bi-weekly and monthly lenses and can order toric lenses for astigmatism and multifocals for reading.

What we offer

  • Daily disposable, bi-weekly and monthly lenses
  • Toric lenses for astigmatism
  • Multifocal lenses
  • Annual supplies — often the best value with rebates and insurance
  • Solutions and lens cases

Good to know

By federal law we need a valid contact lens prescription, which is different from a glasses prescription — it lists the exact lens brand, curve and diameter. It comes from a contact lens exam and fitting by an eye doctor. If yours has expired, you'll need a new exam first.

Turnaroundabout 3 business days for most orders

Contact Lenses: common questions

Can I buy contacts with my glasses prescription?

No. Contact lenses need their own prescription from a contact lens fitting. We're happy to fill a current contact lens prescription from any eye doctor.

Does my vision insurance cover contacts?

Most plans give a contact lens allowance in place of glasses for that benefit period. We'll check which option gives you more value.

Do you keep lenses in stock?

We keep popular lenses on hand and order the rest. Most orders arrive within a few business days.
